title: TechScript
tagline: A modern, human-readable programming language and compiler toolchain built from scratch in Rust.
description: TechScript is an open-source programming language designed to make source code read like clear, structured English while retaining systems-level performance. The ecosystem includes a native Rust compiler, lexer, recursive-descent parser, strict AST representation, stack-based bytecode virtual machine, package manager, and language server.

title: Satvora AI
tagline: AI health coach, multimodal food photo scanner & calorie tracker for Android.
description: Satvora AI is an Android application that combines multimodal computer vision with a comprehensive nutritional taxonomy designed specifically for Indian dietary diversity. It lets users scan meals, track macros, and receive evidence-informed dietary dialogue while keeping personal journal data stored locally on-device.

title: KinotiX
tagline: Interactive 4K live & 3D parallax wallpaper engine published on Google Play.
description: KinotiX is an Android wallpaper engine published on the Google Play Store (com.kinotix.app). It provides dynamic 3D gyroscope parallax depth, interactive touch-reactive fluid simulations, AMOLED deep-black galleries, and transparent live camera backgrounds.

title: NovOS
tagline: A futuristic web-based desktop operating system with neomorphic window management.
description: NovOS is a complete web-based operating system providing a reactive desktop interface, draggable multi-window manager, POSIX virtual file system over IndexedDB, taskbar launcher, and built-in system utilities engineered in React and TypeScript.

title: NeoSketch
tagline: Offline AI-powered artistic photo editor for Android and Windows.
description: NeoSketch is an offline AI-powered artistic photo editor for Android and Windows built with Flutter, Rust, and the ONNX runtime for privacy-first on-device image processing.

title: Vortyx
tagline: Modern Android media downloader and download manager built with Kotlin & Jetpack Compose.
description: Vortyx is a high-performance Android media downloader and transfer manager built with modern Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It provides multi-threaded chunked downloads, pause/resume capability, and smart directory organization.

title: ARC Reactor 3D
tagline: Interactive 3D Iron Man ARC Reactor rendering engine in Three.js and GLSL shaders.
description: An interactive 3D WebGL experience rendering a high-detail Iron Man ARC Reactor with customizable energy core glow, rotating metallic mechanical rings, and dynamic lighting effects.

title: Aurora-OS.js
tagline: Extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework in TypeScript.
description: Aurora-OS.js is an extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework providing a virtual operating system experience with scripting, sandboxed apps, interactive terminals, and gameplay mechanics.

title: OS Wallpapers
tagline: Curated collection of minimalist wallpapers tailored for operating system interfaces.
description: A hand-crafted collection of ambient wallpapers and background textures designed specifically for custom Linux setups, Android ROMs, and desktop operating systems.
